subject: Q4 Engineering Priorities — All-Hands Recap
body:
Team,

Q4 priorities:
1. Payments (NEX-204) — flagship, target Dec 15, Priya leading.
2. Database Migration (NEX-189) — Nov 3 window, Diana.
3. Search Performance (NEX-198) — P95 < 200ms, Riya.
4. API Rate Limiting (NEX-231) — required for Payments, Arjun.
5. Mobile SDK v2 (NEX-210) — mobile team.

Payments is highest priority; escalate blockers immediately.

Raj Patel, CTO
